# Error codes

<!-- Generated by docs/scripts/error-codes.ts from the package sources. Do not edit; run `pnpm --filter @toets/docs errors`. -->

Every toets error has a stable `code`. In test output it reads `ToetsError: [CODE] message`, followed by `Hint:` (likely cause and fix) and `Docs:` (the page to read). Act on the hint first; branch on the code, never on the message.

A `Docs:` path of the form `reference/<package>/docs/<page>` ships with that package at `node_modules/@toets/<package>/docs/<page>.md`; other paths (`concepts/focus`) are pages of the docs site.

Codes from the SDK host (`sdk.*`) surface as `ToetsError` with the same code.

## @toets/core

| Code                    | Meaning                                                                                                   | Docs                                                                                                                                                        |
| ----------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `CAPABILITY_MISSING`    | The action or assertion needs a capability this target does not have (driver, SDK domain or mock server). | [capabilities](./capabilities.md)                                                                                                                           |
| `DEVICE_COMMAND_FAILED` | A `command` device provider command failed.                                                               | [test/devices](../../test/docs/devices.md)                                                                                                                  |
| `DEVICE_COMMAND_OUTPUT` | The device acquire command must print JSON with an "address" on its last line; got.                       | [test/devices](../../test/docs/devices.md)                                                                                                                  |
| `DRIVER_CONTRACT`       | A driver returned something that breaks the `Driver` contract (a driver bug).                             | [capabilities](./capabilities.md)                                                                                                                           |
| `ELEMENT_DETACHED`      | The element a locator resolved to left the screen before it could be read.                                | [text-snapshots](./text-snapshots.md)                                                                                                                       |
| `ELEMENT_NOT_FOUND`     | A locator matched no element within the timeout.                                                          | [focus-navigation](./focus-navigation.md), [locators](./locators.md)                                                                                        |
| `ELEMENT_OFFSCREEN`     | Cannot screenshot an element outside the viewport.                                                        | [screenshots](./screenshots.md)                                                                                                                             |
| `FOCUS_LOOP`            | `pressUntil`: focus came back to an element it already left (a wrap-around).                              | [focus-navigation](./focus-navigation.md)                                                                                                                   |
| `FOCUS_STUCK`           | `pressUntil`: a press did not move focus within `navigationSettleMs`.                                     | [focus-navigation](./focus-navigation.md)                                                                                                                   |
| `FOCUS_UNCHANGED`       | Focus stayed on … for …ms after the action.                                                               | [focus-navigation](./focus-navigation.md)                                                                                                                   |
| `FOCUS_UNREACHABLE`     | `pressUntil` or `navigateTo` gave up: `maxPresses` presses, or no direction left to try.                  | [focus-navigation](./focus-navigation.md)                                                                                                                   |
| `INVALID_ARGUMENT`      | An API received an invalid argument, such as a value that is not a toets Locator or a negative count.     | [screenshots](./screenshots.md), [focus-navigation](./focus-navigation.md), [locators](./locators.md), [assertions](./assertions.md), [remote](./remote.md) |
| `INVALID_DRIVER`        | The configured driver module does not default-export a matching `DriverModule`.                           | [test/config](../../test/docs/config.md)                                                                                                                    |
| `INVALID_SCREENSHOT`    | Not a toets screenshot.                                                                                   | [screenshots](./screenshots.md)                                                                                                                             |
| `INVALID_SUBJECT`       | A matcher received a subject it does not support. Also in @toets/test.                                    | [assertions](./assertions.md)                                                                                                                               |
| `KEY_UNSUPPORTED`       | The platform's remote has no such key, or cannot hold keys.                                               | [remote](./remote.md)                                                                                                                                       |
| `MOCK_DISABLED`         | Network mocking is not enabled for this project.                                                          | [network](./network.md)                                                                                                                                     |
| `MOCK_UNAVAILABLE`      | Network mocking is on, but no mock server is set.                                                         | [network](./network.md)                                                                                                                                     |
| `MODULE_NOT_FOUND`      | Cannot find … (…).                                                                                        | [test/config](../../test/docs/config.md)                                                                                                                    |
| `NO_DEVICES`            | No device addresses were configured for `external` devices.                                               | [test/devices](../../test/docs/devices.md)                                                                                                                  |
| `NO_FOCUS`              | Nothing holds focus, before moving focus or after a press.                                                | [focus-navigation](./focus-navigation.md)                                                                                                                   |
| `NO_MANAGED_DEVICES`    | The driver cannot manage devices for this platform.                                                       | [test/devices](../../test/docs/devices.md)                                                                                                                  |
| `NOT_ENOUGH_DEVICES`    | There are fewer `external` devices than workers.                                                          | [test/devices](../../test/docs/devices.md)                                                                                                                  |
| `SDK_NOT_CONNECTED`     | The app did not connect to the toets SDK host at … within …ms.                                            | [sdk](./sdk.md)                                                                                                                                             |
| `STRICT_MODE_VIOLATION` | A locator matched several elements where exactly one is needed.                                           | [locators](./locators.md)                                                                                                                                   |
| `UNKNOWN_KEY`           | Unknown key ….                                                                                            | [remote](./remote.md)                                                                                                                                       |

## @toets/mock

| Code                        | Meaning                                                                                | Docs                                                         |
| --------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `MOCK_BAD_ORIGIN`           | The origin header is not an `http(s)` origin.                                          | [mock/app-integration](../../mock/docs/app-integration.md)   |
| `MOCK_BAD_REQUEST`          | The request could not be turned into a Fetch `Request` (e.g. unsupported method).      | [mock/concepts](../../mock/docs/concepts.md)                 |
| `MOCK_CLIENT_ABORTED`       | The app closed the connection before the response completed.                           |                                                              |
| `MOCK_HANDLER_ERROR`        | A handler threw.                                                                       | [mock/writing-handlers](../../mock/docs/writing-handlers.md) |
| `MOCK_INTERNAL_ERROR`       | An unexpected failure inside the mock server (a toets bug: please report it).          | [mock/concepts](../../mock/docs/concepts.md)                 |
| `MOCK_INVALID_HANDLER`      | `use()` / `resetHandlers()` received something that is not an MSW request handler.     | [mock/writing-handlers](../../mock/docs/writing-handlers.md) |
| `MOCK_INVALID_OPTION`       | An option passed to `createMockServer()`, `latency()` or `failure()` is invalid.       | [mock/writing-handlers](../../mock/docs/writing-handlers.md) |
| `MOCK_LISTEN_FAILED`        | The server could not start listening for another reason.                               | [mock/concepts](../../mock/docs/concepts.md)                 |
| `MOCK_NETWORK_ERROR`        | A handler returned `HttpResponse.error()`: the connection is dropped on purpose.       |                                                              |
| `MOCK_NO_ORIGIN`            | No handler matched and the request has no origin header, so there is nowhere to proxy. | [mock/app-integration](../../mock/docs/app-integration.md)   |
| `MOCK_PORT_IN_USE`          | The requested port is taken.                                                           | [mock/concepts](../../mock/docs/concepts.md)                 |
| `MOCK_RESPONSE_FAILED`      | The response body failed after headers were sent (upstream reset, broken mock stream). |                                                              |
| `MOCK_UNHANDLED`            | No handler matched and the server runs with `onUnhandledRequest: 'reject'`.            | [mock/writing-handlers](../../mock/docs/writing-handlers.md) |
| `MOCK_UPSTREAM_UNREACHABLE` | Proxying to the real upstream failed before a response arrived.                        | [mock/concepts](../../mock/docs/concepts.md)                 |

## @toets/protocol

| Code                     | Meaning                                                                            | Docs                                         |
| ------------------------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------- |
| `sdk.closed`             | The session closed (app quit, crashed or reloaded) before the request completed.   | [protocol/host](../../protocol/docs/host.md) |
| `sdk.host-closed`        | The host was closed while waiting or requesting.                                   | [protocol/host](../../protocol/docs/host.md) |
| `sdk.listen-failed`      | The host could not open its WebSocket server.                                      | [protocol/host](../../protocol/docs/host.md) |
| `sdk.method-unsupported` | The SDK did not announce the domain, or its protocol version predates the method.  | [protocol/spec](../../protocol/docs/spec.md) |
| `sdk.remote-error`       | The SDK answered with an error. `rpcCode` and `data` carry the details.            |                                              |
| `sdk.request-timeout`    | The app did not answer a request in time.                                          | [protocol/host](../../protocol/docs/host.md) |
| `sdk.session-timeout`    | The app did not complete the handshake in time.                                    | [protocol/host](../../protocol/docs/host.md) |
| `sdk.unknown-token`      | `waitForSession` was called with a token this host never issued (or that expired). | [protocol/host](../../protocol/docs/host.md) |
